headlines.title: GTA 6 broke every record, and Take-Two's real test starts now
headlines.summary: Bank of America raised its Take-Two target after the launch, but one number in its note shows why the cheering may be early.

headlines.title: S&P 500, Nasdaq End Best Session Since April Last Year On Optimism Led By Jensen Huang’s Reinstatement — NVDA, NASA, TTWO, AMZN In Focus
headlines.summary: Nvidia’s board reinstated Jensen Huang as Nvidia’s CEO following pressure from President Donald Trump.

headlines.title: GTA VI Broke Every Record in 24 Hours, So Why Did Take-Two Shareholders Sell?
headlines.summary: Rockstar posted a record-shattering launch and a near-perfect review score, yet Take-Two investors headed for the exits. The real money behind this franchise sits somewhere the day-one sales figures never touch, and it has not even launched.

headlines.title: GTA VI Hype More Than Doubled Sony’s US PS5 And Microsoft’s Xbox Weekly Sales, Circana Says
headlines.summary: The firm said PlayStation 5 sales were more than 2.4 times higher than a year earlier during the week ended Nov. 7, while Xbox Series sales rose to 2.3 times their year-ago level.

headlines.title: Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia: Long or short accountability?
headlines.summary: Market Hang tackles the top stories of the day. Including Nvidia's board unanimously reinstating Jensen Huang as CEO and what the White House's involvement says about accountability in corporate America, whether the government has effectively put a floor under the AI trade, and Anthropic falling as options on the stock begin trading for the first time. The panel, with Yahoo Finance's Julie Hyman, debates where everyone sits on a one-to-five bullishness scale, whether this is a stock picker's market or a CapEx bubble that precedes a secular bear, the risk of a politically driven slowdown in data center construction, and OpenAI's chief scientist calling for a speed limit on AI development, including whether an FDA-style regulator is the right model for AI.

description: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. develops, publishes, and markets interactive entertainment solutions for consumers worldwide. The company develops and publishes action/adventure products under the Grand Theft Auto, LA Noire, Max Payne, Midnight Club, and Red Dead Redemption names, as well as other franchises. It also publishes various entertainment properties across various platforms and a range of genres, such as shooter, action, role-playing, strategy, sports, and family/casual entertainment under the BioShock, Mafia, Sid Meier's Civilization, XCOM series, Borderlands, and Tiny Tina's Wonderland names. In addition, the company publishes sports simulation titles comprising NBA 2K series, a basketball video game; the WWE 2K professional wrestling series; mobile titles, including WWE SuperCard; and PGA TOUR 2K. Further, it offers free-to-play mobile games, such as CSR Racing, Dragon City, Empires & Puzzles, FarmVille 3, Game of Thrones: Legends, Golf Rival, Harry Potter: Puzzles & Spells, Hit It Rich!, Match Factory!, Merge Dragons!, Merge Magic!, Monster Legends, NBA 2K, Toon Blast, Top Eleven, Wizard Of Oz Slots Casino, Toy Blast, Words With Friends, and Zynga Poker; and Color Block Jam. The company's products are designed for console gaming systems; and mobiles, such as smartphones, tablets, and personal computers. It provides its products through physical retail, digital download, online platforms, and cloud streaming services. Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. was incorporated in 1993 and is based in New York, New York.
